episodes.title: The Dandelions Fly Off into the Sky
The Substitution Rope Story
episodes.description: Nobita, hearing Shizuka's wish to climb trees and play baseball, suggests, "Well, let's try switching bodies for a while!" He borrows a "Switching Rope" from Doraemon, which allows them to switch bodies while keeping their minds the same. The two immediately switch bodies. Shizuka, now in Nobita's form, is overjoyed to enjoy tree climbing, something she had always wanted, and to do well in baseball. She says she wants to stay like this for a while. Meanwhile, Nobita is constantly being scolded by Shizuka's mother for "misbehaving badly"...!?

The Devil Passport
episodes.description:
Nobita wants to buy a manga book and asks for an advance on his allowance, but his mom firmly refuses. Unable to give up, he tries to secretly get the money early, but gets scolded and becomes discouraged. Frustrated, he decides, “If that’s how it is, I’ll just become a total villain!” and takes the “Devil’s Passport” from Doraemon. It is a terrifying passport that allows him to get away with any wrongdoing.

Freed from being scolded, Nobita begins doing only bad things (like kicking empty cans and trash bags) taking advantage of the fact that no one can punish him.

My Birthday is the Same as Always
episodes.description: Even though it’s his birthday, Nobita feels disappointed because he worries his parents’ present will once again not match what he wanted. Trying to distract himself, he visits Shizuka’s house, but while waiting for her to return, he becomes impatient and asks Doraemon for a way to skip wasted time. Doraemon then introduces the “Time Warp Reel,” a gadget that allows them to jump forward in time, leading Nobita to experiment with fast-forwarding to the moment Shizuka comes home.

Zou no Hana ni Natta Shizuka-chan
3cm Nobita's Adventures
episodes.description: During summer vacation, Nobita is accidentally stranded after drifting away in a tiny bamboo boat while shrunk by Doraemon’s “Gulliver Tunnel.” Doraemon and Shizuka try to rescue him, but Gian and Suneo insist on shrinking down too so they can experience the miniature world themselves. As the group travels through the dangerous micro-world to find Nobita, they are attacked by a crow while riding a balloon raft. In the chaos, Doraemon accidentally drops the “Big Light,” the gadget needed to restore their normal size, making the rescue even more difficult.

I Love You, Roboko
episodes.description: Nobita becomes overjoyed after being praised by girls for his ability to catch peanuts in his mouth. However, he later discovers that they only praised him out of politeness, leaving him deeply disappointed. Feeling sorry for him, Doraemon brings a “Friend Robot” named Robo-ko from the future, programmed to love only Nobita. Robo-ko is not only cute but also constantly praises everything Nobita does, making him extremely happy. However, she gradually begins to become overly possessive of him, trying to keep him all to herself.

episodes.title: The Dwarf Robot
episodes.description: Nobita is scolded by his mom for napping instead of doing homework, and wishes for a tool like in fairy tales that can do work while he sleeps. Doraemon gives him the “Little Helper Box,” which summons tiny robots to complete any task requested before sleeping. Nobita first tests it with small chores like polishing shoes, and the robots successfully complete everything. Encouraged by this, he starts using the box to help others with increasingly larger tasks, gaining praise and confidence, but eventually becomes overconfident and takes on too many requests.

episodes.title: Hito no Mi ni Naru Tachibagan
Convenient Treasure Island
episodes.description: Nobita and his friends go on a sea adventure as part of a spring break request, with Doraemon using a gadget to create a “moderate” treasure island experience. They are guided by a dolphin-like robot named Hodho, but the adventure turns strange when the treasure they find is just merchandise instead of real riches. After Gian and Suneo complain, Doraemon increases the difficulty, leading to real danger: storms, malfunctioning gadgets, and transformations into sea creatures to survive. The group eventually discovers the true treasure inside a whale, but the adventure keeps shifting between too easy and too hard, leaving them confused as Hodho insists everything is “just right.”

episodes.title: Hanbun no Hanbun no Mata Hanbun...
Toki o Hashire! Time Karimono Kyousou
Hitoban de Kaki no Makoto ga Natta
All alone in the city of the future
episodes.description: Nobita travels to the 22nd century after Doraemon leaves, only to discover a seemingly deserted futuristic city where he encounters anti-gravity tech, strange shops, and what he believes is an alien invasion. He meets Sewashi, who explains everything is actually part of a 3D game called “Intruders,” not a real crisis. Embarrassed but relieved, Nobita learns Doraemon was only temporarily away for repairs. Doraemon later returns, and they go back to the 20th century together, where Nobita immediately wants to keep playing the game.

episodes.title: Let's Skate on the Moon Craters!
episodes.description: Nobita is mocked by Gian and Suneo at the park for not being able to skateboard, though Suneo gives him an old board to try. Feeling frustrated, Nobita asks Doraemon for help, and Doraemon brings a gadget called the “Otasuke Hat,” which is meant to prevent injuries when falling from sliding sports. However, Nobita is too scared of falling and cannot use it properly. Later, Shizuka arrives and skillfully rides a skateboard while wearing the hat, impressing everyone. Doraemon becomes disappointed in Nobita’s fear, though he reflects that Nobita might feel more confident in a lighter-gravity environment.

episodes.title: Is it okay if Doraemon isn't around?!
episodes.description: Doraemon received several sample items from the future department store like a Raw Material Lights. He doesn't need all the sample gadgets offered and threw them in the trash. But for Nobita this is an interesting thing. Then Nobita bring a shopping bag and put all the sample gadgets into the bag. Before Nobita left the house he accidentally use Raw Material Lights to turn Doraemon's Dorayaki into raw materials, this make Doraemon angry with him.

episodes.title: Nobita will disappear?
episodes.description: Nobita becomes anxious after a situation makes him think he might vanish from existence. As he spirals into worry, Doraemon uses his gadgets to investigate and help him understand what’s really happening. The episode mixes comedy with a more unsettling idea, showing Nobita’s fear of being forgotten and the reassurance he finds through Doraemon’s support.
